description: Confirmed by 2+ sources / Single source / Claimed, not confirmed / None found / Not researched / Not graded. "None found": researched (or official text read) and no tolerance statement found - not evidence of no tolerance. "Not researched": no web research yet AND the official Seednet/CSC text has stress wording that the rule tagger could not grade (needs research). "Not graded": no web research AND no stress statement in the official text at all. A researched record is never "Not researched" or "Not graded". "Single source" also when the only source is the official text tagged by rule (stress_basis = official text only). The analysis fields are this and stress_types_confirmed.
